The Dream to Enhance
Our Community for Residents
and Visitors Alike
A scenic corridor with a hike and bike trail along
Corpus Christi Bay, Oso Bay, Cayo Del Oso and Oso
Creek to enrich the residents of our community
and provide an attraction to visitors. It also
provides pedestrians and bicyclists opportunities
to view the City’s diverse natural habitat and
wildlife.
The Bay Trail is Our Gift
Phase I and II of the Bay Trail extends eight miles
along the Corpus Christi Bay from the Barge Dock
near the Arena and Bayfront Plaza Convention
Center to Texas A&M University-Corpus Christi
on Ocean Drive. Phase III is the planned future
extension of this trail along Ennis Joslin to South
Padre Island Drive and eventually through the
City’s Southside.
Let the Adventure Begin...
Our climate offers ideal conditions for kiteboarding
and windsurfing, attracting people from around
the world! Our constant windy conditions also
offer sailors lots of year-round play! It’s time for
you to enjoy it, too. What will it be for you today?
